background: A former UConn student manager and Holy Cross/Florida assistant (under Billy Donovan), Daigneault coached the Oklahoma City Blue in the G League from 2014-19, joined the Thunder bench in 2019-20 and was promoted to head coach in November 2020 at age 35. He oversaw the full teardown (22-50, 24-58) and the rise: a play-in in 2022-23, the West's No. 1 seed and Coach of the Year in 2023-24, a franchise-record 68-14 and the 2025 NBA championship, and a 64-18 season (inferred) in 2025-26 that ended with a Game 7 Western Conference Finals loss to San Antonio. Career marks of 275-207 (regular season) and 26-11 (playoffs) through the 2026 first round; he has never lost a first-round series. Signed a contract extension in 2024. Known for a problem-solving, experiment-heavy approach, a league-best pressure defense, a data-driven challenge system and heavy trust in young players.
